SCOPE OF WORK FOR INFORMATION SYSTEMS CONSULTING SERVICES –
Community Action Partnership of Kern
RFP IS 2025-001

Page 3

CAPK is seeking proposals from qualified, licensed and bonded entities with demonstrated
professional competence and experience to provide necessary Information Systems Consultant
services on an as-needed basis.

This proposal is not an offer to buy and should not be assumed
as such.

Project Overview
Community Action Partnership of Kern (CAPK) seeks a qualified consulting partner to act as an
extension of our Information Systems team.

The consultant will provide expertise in application
development, AI integration, security enhancements, and assist with a strategic migration to
Microsoft Fabric.

The engagement will include advisory, implementation, and knowledge
transfer components.

Objectives
a.
Enhance CAPK’s application development capabilities for internal and external systems.
b.

Integrate AI solutions aligned with CAPK’s approved AI Use Policy for ethical and secure
deployment.
c.

Assist with planning and development of 211 call center database migration to
Dynamics and integration of Intelligent Virtual Assistant using AI and natural language
processing.
d.
Plan and execute migration to Microsoft Fabric for analytics and data integration.
e.

Ensure cybersecurity posture through assessments, remediation, and best-practice
implementation.

Services and Deliverables
a.

Application Development & Special Projects
i.
Develop and maintain custom applications to support CAPK operations.
ii.

Provide architecture reviews and recommendations for scalability and
performance.
iii.
Deliver technical documentation and training for CAPK staff.
b.

AI Integration
i.
Assess current environment for AI readiness.
ii.
Design and implement AI-driven solutions for operational efficiency.
iii.
Ensure compliance with CAPK’s AI Use Policy and data privacy standards.
iv.
Conduct bias and fairness audits for deployed AI models.
c.

211 Service Enhancement
i.

Develop a migration plan and data model for the 211 call center database to
move into Dynamics 365, ensuring compatibility with existing client relationship
management (CRM) workflows.
ii.

Implement an Intelligent Virtual Assistant (IVA) using AI and natural language
processing (NLP) technologies to handle call triage, knowledge base queries, and
client engagement.
iii.

Collaborate with CAPK’s 211 leadership to ensure the solution enhances service
delivery while maintaining compliance with data privacy and confidentiality
standards.
d.

Microsoft Fabric Migration
i.
Evaluate existing data architecture and analytics workflows.
ii.
Develop migration roadmap for Microsoft Fabric adoption.

Community Action Partnership of Kern
RFP IS 2025-001

Page 4
iii.
Execute migration with minimal disruption to business operations.
iv.
Provide post-migration optimization and performance tuning.
e.

Project Management
i.
Assign a dedicated project manager to coordinate tasks and timelines.
ii.
Conduct weekly status meetings and provide bi-weekly progress reports.
iii.
Maintain transparent communication with CAPK stakeholders.
f.

Compliance and Standards
i.
Adhere to CAPK’s IT governance, AI Use Policy, and security protocols.
ii.

Follow industry best practices for software development, data security, and
cloud migration.

b.

c.

b.

c.

Ability to provide references for similar projects in nonprofit or public sector
environments.
